description: Cicely expands from Joel's exile into a true ensemble world as relationships, family histories, Native traditions, spiritual encounters and improbable events keep forcing its residents to reconsider who they are and what belonging means.

s03e01.description: Adam drags Joel into treating hypochondriac Eve and their volatile marriage, while Maggie discovers Rick had another girlfriend and Maurice's courtship of Barbara hits an ethical wall.

s03e02.description: Chris discovers his pheromones attract nearly every woman except the optometrist he wants, while Maurice and Holling reopen old resentment over Shelly and Maggie confronts aging.

s03e03.description: An emergency landing leaves Maggie and Joel stranded and arguing over survival, while Shelly's visiting best friend puts unexpected strain on life at the Brick.

s03e04.description: Maggie becomes convinced Rick has been reincarnated as a dog, Maurice dreams of an ostrich empire, and Ed turns his camera toward ordinary Cicely life.

s03e05.description: After a head injury, Joel is confronted by his slick, disreputable twin Jules, whose arrival lets the brothers swap places and destabilize Joel's already fragile sense of control.

s03e06.description: A century-old frozen body forces Cicely to debate history, ownership and mortality, while Maurice spots a business opportunity and Shelly wonders about fertility.

s03e07.description: Elaine returns to Cicely as a widow and Maggie unexpectedly nudges her toward Joel, while a gifted new cook changes expectations at the Brick.

s03e08.description: Joel reluctantly joins Chris and Holling for hunting season, while Ed becomes convinced death is stalking Ruth-Anne and tries to protect her.

s03e09.description: A stranded performance troupe brings a silent flying man who charms Marilyn, while Shelly is wounded when Holling comments on a physical insecurity.

s03e10.description: Christmas brings Joel his first tree in Cicely and Maurice an unexpected Korean family connection, while the town stages its own idiosyncratic holiday pageant.

s03e11.description: Maurice hires a secretive reporter to enliven his newspaper, Maggie finds meaning in talking to trees, and Chris becomes financially entangled with the Brick.

s03e12.description: A grateful elder adopts Joel into his clan after giving him a goat, while Holling mysteriously closes the Brick and leaves everyone guessing why.

s03e13.description: Ed documents an elder's disappearing cultural knowledge while Holling, at sixty-three, is abruptly seized by a midlife crisis.

s03e14.description: Maggie's impeccably polite mother arrives with unsettling news, while Chris becomes consumed by an ambitious and dangerous new piece of performance art.

s03e15.description: Holling's comfortable position as mayor is challenged by Edna, whose campaign turns a forgotten civic promise into a surprisingly serious election.

s03e16.description: Holling and Maurice head deep into the wilderness to honor a promise and bury an old friend, only to find the dead man's widow complicating the expedition.

s03e17.description: Joel becomes convinced his house is haunted by a long-dead loner, while Eve acquires fresh symptoms and Maurice eagerly accepts a favor for an old military acquaintance.

s03e18.description: An abandoned infant in Joel's waiting room becomes a town-wide responsibility just as Shelly receives an unexpected visit from her mother.

s03e19.description: Spring transforms Cicely: Shelly searches for renewal, Joel refreshes his medical instincts and Maggie experiences an awakening that makes old emotional boundaries harder to maintain.

s03e20.description: Japanese visitors arrive for a northern-lights ritual, Holling resumes his search for Jesse the bear, and a mysterious well-traveled package captivates the town.

s03e21.description: Joel's hoped-for medical weekend in Juneau becomes an awkward shared hotel stay with Maggie, while Bernard's return unsettles Chris's sense of identity.

s03e22.description: Adam and Eve's wedding reveals an unexpected truth about the bride, while Joel and Maggie consider finishing the romantic encounter they began in Juneau.

s03e23.description: An elderly visitor recounts how Cicely began as a frontier haven for artists, outsiders and free thinkers, revealing the town's idealistic founding story.
